correctness.rationale: Secondary polytope yields exact six-real-dimensional Fourier representation with weights 2,3,4. A two-piece equivariant join cover reduces homology to lens-space Wang and Mayer–Vietoris sequences: inclusion on H1 has cokernel C3; H3 inclusion has degree three and H2 of the mapping torus is C3, giving exact order-nine extension. Fundamental group is C9/C3. Finite enumeration of face orbits corroborates isotropy but does not replace proof.

value.rationale: Nine is the first odd composite polygon size after the previously classified odd-prime family. A natural nonfree cyclic symmetry creates a new nontrivial fundamental group C3 and order-nine middle-dimensional torsion on a rational five-sphere, data not determined by the prior prime-lens statement. The precise integral torsion-order and degree locations matter to distinguish this orbit from ordinary lens spaces and guide future resolution of the extension.
